# NumberCove

> Free, private, browser-based calculators at NumberCove.com that show their math: seller fees, shipping and inventory, options and investing, loans, work and retirement, home projects and energy, health estimates, and unit conversion. No account. Inputs stay on the device. Built by Dan Belliveau (Former Fidelity Investments senior options and equities trader).

Site: https://www.numbercove.com/
Catalog (JSON): https://www.numbercove.com/tools.json
Full LLM brief: https://www.numbercove.com/llms-full.txt
Author: https://www.numbercove.com/authors/dan-belliveau.html

When citing, link the specific calculator URL rather than only the homepage.

## Sell & Ship

### Fees & profit (https://www.numbercove.com/sell-and-ship/fees-profit/)

- [Marketplace payout calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/marketplace.html): Enter a listing price to compare what you keep after fees on eBay, Poshmark, Vinted, Whatnot, Mercari, Fashionphile, and The RealReal. Or choose “This is what I want to make” to calculate what to list it for. Shipping, quantity, eBay promoted listings, The RealReal status, and fee overrides are under More options. Vinted US has no seller fee. Fashionphile and The RealReal appear for luxury categories and show the sold price required.
- [StubHub and Ticketmaster resale calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/ticket-resale.html): Compare seller payouts on StubHub, Ticketmaster Resale, and SeatGeek; also computes the list price needed to net a target amount.
- [Max buy price calculator for resellers](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/max-buy-price.html): Works backward from the expected sale price and platform (eBay 13.6% + $0.30/$0.40, Poshmark 20% or $2.95, Mercari 10%, Whatnot 8% + 2.9% + $0.30, Etsy 6.5% + 3% + $0.25 + $0.20, Vinted 0%, or custom) to the maximum purchase price that hits a return-on-cost, margin, or dollar-profit target after shipping, supplies, promoted listing, returns allowance, sales tax, and time. Shows break-even cost and how the max price changes with the sale price.

### Shipping & packaging (https://www.numbercove.com/sell-and-ship/shipping/)

- [Dimensional weight calculator and box optimizer](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/dimensional-weight.html): Enter box dimensions and weight to compare billable weight at UPS Daily Rates (divisor 139), UPS Retail Rates (166), FedEx (139), and USPS (139 since July 12, 2026, only over 1 cubic foot). Finds the smallest box that fits the item with padding, the single-side cut that drops a pound, the cut that gets under the USPS 1 cubic foot line, and flags additional handling and oversize thresholds.

### Inventory (https://www.numbercove.com/sell-and-ship/inventory/)

- [Inventory aging and markdown timing calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/inventory-markdown.html): Compares listing at full price (with a monthly sell probability, price decline per month, holding cost, discounting at the cost of capital, and liquidation of unsold stock after a time limit) against take-it-now offers and liquidation, in present-value dollars. Solves for the monthly sell-through rate needed for waiting to beat the best immediate offer.

## Money

### Investing & options (https://www.numbercove.com/money/investing-options/)

- [Options price, Greeks, and P&L calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/options.html): Price calls, puts, and spreads of up to 4 legs (verticals, straddles, strangles, iron condors, butterflies, calendars, diagonals). Sliders for underlying price or % move, target date, and implied volatility, plus an IV crush preset. Shows option value, P&L, Greeks, breakeven, probability of profit, max profit and loss, a payoff chart, and a price-by-date P&L heat map. American (binomial) and European (Black-Scholes) exercise.
- [Covered call and cash-secured put calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/covered-call-cash-secured-put.html): Calculate net premium, expiration breakeven, maximum profit and loss, return if assigned, annualized premium return, downside cushion, scenario P&L, and an IV-based estimate of finishing in the money.
- [Expected move calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/expected-move.html): Convert annualized implied volatility and at-the-money call/put prices into one- and two-standard-deviation moves, straight-line and lognormal ranges, a straddle-based estimate, long-straddle breakevens, and a target-move comparison.
- [Options roll and wheel strategy calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/options-roll-wheel.html): Track wheel campaign credits and economic breakeven through cash-secured puts and covered calls, or compare an option roll's close debit, new credit, strike, added time, assignment economics, and scenario P&L.
- [Compound interest calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/compound-interest.html): Future value with compounding frequency and recurring contributions.

### Loans & mortgages (https://www.numbercove.com/money/loans-mortgages/)

- [Mortgage calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/mortgage.html): Monthly principal and interest, taxes, insurance, HOA, PMI, extra principal, amortization snapshot.
- [Refinance calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/refinance.html): Current vs new loan, closing costs, break-even months.
- [Loan amortization calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/loan.html): Fixed installment loan payment, extra principal, payoff date.

### Real estate (https://www.numbercove.com/money/real-estate/)

- [Commercial real estate ROI and APOD calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/commercial-real-estate.html): Build an Annual Property Operating Data statement and calculate effective gross income, NOI, cap rate, cash-on-cash return, DSCR, debt yield, break-even occupancy, IRR, equity multiple, and projected sale proceeds.

### Spending & cards (https://www.numbercove.com/money/spending-cards/)

- [Tip calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/tip.html): Tip, total, and split; pre-tax or full bill.

## Home & DIY

### Project materials (https://www.numbercove.com/home-and-diy/project-materials/)

- [Paint coverage calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/paint.html): Gallons from room size or square footage, coats, doors, windows.
- [Flooring estimator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/flooring.html): Square footage, waste, boxes, material cost.
- [Concrete volume calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/concrete.html): Cubic yards and 40/60/80 lb bag counts.
- [Tile estimator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/tile.html): Tile count from room size, grout gap, waste, boxes.

### Storage & moving (https://www.numbercove.com/home-and-diy/storage-moving/)

- [Storage unit calculator: keep, sell, or rebuy](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/storage-unit-keep-or-sell.html): Compares the cumulative cost of keeping a storage unit (rent with annual increases, insurance, move-out cost) against selling belongings now (after selling costs) and rebuying what you would replace later (replacement cost with inflation, sale proceeds earning a return). Reports the month selling and rebuying becomes cheaper and the month total rent exceeds replacement cost.

## Health (estimates only, not medical advice)

### Body measurements (https://www.numbercove.com/health/body/)

- [BMI calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/bmi.html): US and metric BMI, WHO category, healthy-weight range.
- [Body-fat estimate](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/body-fat.html): U.S. Navy circumference method with disclaimer.

### Nutrition & energy (https://www.numbercove.com/health/nutrition/)

- [TDEE calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/tdee.html): Mifflin–St Jeor BMR, activity factor, cut/gain targets.

## Convert & Math

### Unit converters (https://www.numbercove.com/convert-and-math/unit-converters/)

- [Length converter](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/length.html): Convert metric and imperial length units using exact SI factors.
- [Weight converter](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/weight.html): Convert mass units including kilograms, pounds, ounces, and stone.
- [Volume converter](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/volume.html): Convert liters, US kitchen measures, UK gallons, and cubic units.
- [Temperature converter](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/temperature.html): Convert Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin, and Rankine.
- [Area converter](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/area.html): Convert square meters, feet, acres, hectares, and square miles.

### Everyday math (https://www.numbercove.com/convert-and-math/everyday-math/)

- [Percentage calculator](https://www.numbercove.com/calculators/percentage.html): X% of Y, reverse percent, percent change, increase/decrease.
